# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Genres, themes and moods

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com

Lookup lists used for song filters (genres, themes, moods, artists, cover artists, languages, stream dates) and the detail pages for a single genre, theme or mood.

The `/api/filters/*` endpoints share the same parameters: `search` (case-insensitive substring), `page` (zero-based, default 0) and `pageSize` (default 50). The returned IDs can be passed to the song search filters.

### `GET /api/genres/{id}` — Get a genre

Auth: none

Returns a single genre with its description, its songs and related tags.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | `string` | yes |  |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id: string | null
  name: string | null
  description: string | null
  songs: {
    id: string | null
    title: string | null
    opus: string | null
    oss: string | null
    cnPath: string | null
    absolutePath: string | null
    playCount: int | null
    duration: int | null
    streamDate: date-time | null
    dateAdded: date-time | null
    coverArtists: string[] | null
    originalArtists: string[] | null
    genres: string[] | null
    coverArt: {
      id: string | null
      fileName: string | null
      contentType: string | null
      description: string | null
      isAnimated: bool
      credit: string | null
      cloudflareId: string | null
      mediaStorageType: int  // Possible values: `0` = Blob, `1` = Cloudflare, `2` = Badge
      absolutePath: string | null
      artist: {
        id: string | null
        name: string | null
        socialLink: string | null
        userId: string | null
        arts: object[] | null
      }
      upvotes: int
      tagString: string | null
      mediaTag: int  // Possible values: `0` = Neuro, `1` = Evil, `2` = Twins, `3` = Hiyori
    }
    thumbnailArt: { …same as `coverArt` above }
    order: int
    hasLyrics: bool
    userUploaded: bool
    videoId: string | null
    hls: string | null
  }[] | null
  relatedTags: {
    id: string | null
    name: string | null
    songCount: int
  }[] | null
}
```

### `GET /api/filters/genres` — List genres

Auth: none

Returns genres matching `search`, for use as song filter options.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `search` | query | `string` | no |  |
| `page` | query | `int` | no |  |
| `pageSize` | query | `int` | no |  |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id: string | null
  name: string | null
  count: int
}[]
```
